title: Creating a Backup for Zscaler Client Connector Settings

blocks.text: You can create a backup of Zscaler Client Connector configuration settings and restore them using the backup. To learn more, see About Backup and Restore for Zscaler Client Connector.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Administration > Back Up and Restore > Client Connector.
Backup Name: Enter a name to identify the backup.
Description: (Optional) Enter additional notes or information.

blocks.text: If the number of backups reaches a limit of 5, you cannot add a new backup manually without deleting an existing one.
After you create a backup, it displays in the list of backups on the Backup and Restore page.
